data.one_liner: Flutter image viewer library with pinch-zoom, double-tap zoom, vertical dismiss, and hero animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a lightweight photo viewing widget that supports pinch-to-zoom, double-tap zoom, swipe-to-dismiss, multi-image pagination, and hero animations. It works with assets, network images, and file paths.
use_when: You need a full-screen image viewer with pinch-to-zoom and swipe-to-dismiss.
You are building a photo gallery or image preview experience with pagination.
avoid_when: You need complex image editing features like cropping or filters.
You are building a custom canvas drawing app.
strengths: Supports pinch-to-zoom, double-tap zoom, and swipe-to-dismiss out of the box.
Handles multiple image sources including assets, network, and files.
Includes custom overlay support and hero animation transitions.
weaknesses: Limited to viewing and interacting with photos, lacks editing capabilities.
Relies on standard Flutter image handling and cached_network_image.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: A well-established and widely used alternative for zoomable images and galleries in Flutter.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to download and cache images without full-screen viewer interactions.
